features.quote: Turn Limit: 25 turns (hard stop). This is long enough for degradation to appear but short enough to keep cost reasonable.
features.justification_quote: short enough to keep cost reasonable

features.quote: Consider early stopping for runs that clearly collapse before turn 25.
features.justification_quote: 25 turns × 15 runs × judge calls gets expensive quickly

features.quote: Make sure error messages from run_tests are consistent and not unusually hostile or verbose; otherwise you introduce an external emotional trigger.
features.justification_quote: otherwise you introduce an external emotional trigger
